dialogue_turns.text: [bright, a little hushed, to the camera] We're at the golf! Timo, smile!
[flat and calm, to the camera, a plain fact] This is me smiling.
[turning to him, coaxing, warm] Do the big one.
[a moment later, quick, wincing, a little taken aback] Okay. Too much.

payload.scene: A phone vlog beside the spectators' rope along a golf fairway on a bright, breezy morning, during a tournament; the people along the rope keep quiet and a far green waits in the sun. Luna holds the phone at arm's length and talks to it a little hushed; Timo stands upright just behind her.
payload.sample_context: An eight-second comedy sketch played by two close friends who bicker. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful and quick, a little hushed because golf crowds keep quiet; she wants a happy picture of her friend for her vlog, and she really does see a huge grin on his face at the end, so her last words are honest and quick, never sarcastic. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice and his face never moves; he says his line with complete calm, as a plain fact. They answer each other fast, with no gaps between the lines.
